description: repeat-tests.js が使う、試験ごとの自身の上限（ms）。所要時間がこの半分を超えたら失敗とする。規則は、試験名のある規則、ファイル名だけの規則（* を含まないもの）、* を含む規則の順に優先する。exempt の試験は所要時間を比べない（理由を書く）。

rules.reason: 各試験の runInHeadlessChrome の timeoutMs: 30000
leakageTest の runInHeadlessChrome の timeoutMs: 30000

rules.name: UI SEC-34: a second real browsing context updating the database locks this tab and the newer value survives
UI SEC-34: a save waiting for the exclusive lock while another context writes never restores the stale value
UI SEC-34: a guest tab shows the reason in the guest notice after another context updates the database
UI SEC-30: long derived values (4102-character seat key, 8193-character full name and household key) survive an actual restart
UI runner: timeout terminates an unfinished scenario and cleans browser resources
rules.exempt: runner の時間切れそのもの（timeoutMs: 1500）を確かめる試験で、上限を超えて止まるのが正しい

rules.name: security: updating waits for every save before navigation
mutate: restoring across files, argument checks, line ranges without candidates and the timeout reaching the run
mutate: an interrupt, a termination or a hangup stops the running test process group, removes the copy and exits with the signal code
